lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Semi-regular grid of high-intensity white spots arranged in horizontal and vertical axes; highest density observed in the mid-flank region posterior to the branchial slits.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of lighter pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, forming a discernible grid-like pattern across the mid-lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Single prominent longitudinal ridge visible across the upper-mid lateral flank, exhibiting a sharp transition from high-luminance top to low-luminance bottom indicating physical relief.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple slender, low-luminance elongated bio-forms (remoras) attached to the ventral-lateral region and trailing the pectoral fin.
